description: Continues a run that is waiting at a human decision. Call it only with the person's own answer: approve, reject (ends the run with no result), or revise with a note saying what to change. Pass the seen_sha256 and approval_id from the waiting result, so the decision applies to the exact text the person saw. Returns at the next decision or when the run ends.
name: resume_run
title: Resume a run with the person's decision
